name: WDB Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: WDB Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides human resources services in Japan and internationally. It operates through Human Resources Services Business and Contract Research Organization (CRO) Business segments. The company offers registered and permanent temporary staffing, placement, and recruitment services for scientific researchers, engineering technical, and general clerical positions.
